name: Che com
summary: Chè cốm is a sweet soup made from young green rice. The tourism center names it with the other dishes from cốm Vòng.
origin: Hanoi, from cốm Vòng, on the tourism center’s village note.
howToEat: The note calls it a sweet soup and does not print a topping list.
where: Vòng village, Cầu Giấy. The hour is Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Che com — Hanoi green-rice sweet soup
seoDescription: Chè cốm is the sweet soup the tourism center names from cốm Vòng in Cầu Giấy. A topping list was not printed.
